nodes.label: .`the Rajoo machine code starts the first session, answering catalog choices as include`()
.`without a session any other code is rejected and nothing is sent`()
.`during a session a pallet is identified, prefilled to one bag, and captured in the session`()
.`scanning the Rajoo machine code during a session ends it, and once complete closes the job`()
.`a pallet that matches no BOM ingredient is rejected with the reason`()
.`an unanswered Rajoo command for this job blocks scanning and finishing`()
.`a General command with the same target id does not block the Rajoo job`()
.`Rajoo identify of an unknown pallet shows not recognised`()
